description: This file defines an enum 'PermissionMonitoringSupport' with static methods to enable, disable, and stop permission monitoring, utilizing a singleton 'PermissionMonitor'. It manages monitoring state and registers or unregisters as needed.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the 'shouldMonitor' flag, updating the 'monitoring' state and registering or unregistering accordingly.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring if it is currently active by updating the 'monitoring' state and unregistering.
